agenda_text:
CITIZENS’ ADVISORY COMMISSION ON DISABILITIES AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 11, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 1:00 PM
Gretchen Swanson, Chair  Ashley Jones, Member
Chaka Garbutt, Vice Chair  Randy Hope, Member
Julie Dean, Secretary  Arthur Romo, Member
Stephen Adams, Member  Kim Vuong, Member
Marissa Gonzalez, Member

  REVISED

  Citizens' Advisory Commission on Disabilities In-Person Meeting

  Members of the public have the option to submit online and email public comments
  to ada@longbeach.gov

  Comments may also be provided in the Zoom meeting using the raise hand function or by
  pressing *9 on your phone

  Please dial: (213) 338-8477 / Meeting ID: 930 3112 3898
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/93031123898

 Please note the Zoom meeting may encounter technical disruptions, but in-person access and
  public comment will continue to be available in accordance with the Brown Act

  To view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone
  visit: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55422  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Citizens’ Advisory Commission on
  Disabilities meeting of Thursday, May 14, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55423  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from The LGBTQ Center Long
  Beach on its programs and services, including efforts to support equitable access
  and serve LGBTQ+ individuals with disabilities.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55424  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the City of Long Beach,
  Community Development Department on the Housing Element and Accessibility
  Education and Training Program Update.

  Page 1 of 2
   CITIZENS’ ADVISORY COMMISSION ON DISABILITIES AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 11, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 1:00 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55425  Recommendation to discuss and approve the Citizens’ Advisory Commission on
  Disabilities 2025-2026 Annual Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-55426  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

ELECTION OF CHAIR, VICE CHAIR, AND SECRETARY

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Citizens' Advisory Commission on Disabilities on non-agenda items. Each
speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact ada@longbeach.gov.

ELECTION OF CHAIR, VICE CHAIR, AND SECRETARY

A motion was made by Commissioner Romo, to elect Chair Swanson for Chair of the Citizens’
Advisory Commission on Disabilities. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  5  Romo, Vuong, Dean, Garbutt, Swanson
No:  0  None
Recused:  0  None
Abstain:  0  None
Absent:  4  Adams, Gonzalez, Hope, Jones

A motion was made by Secretary Dean, to elect Vice Chair Garbutt for Vice Chair of the
Citizens’ Advisory Commission on Disabilities. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  5  Romo, Vuong, Dean, Garbutt, Swanson
No:  0  None

Abstain:  0  None

A motion was made by Vice Chair Garbutt, to elect Secretary Dean for Secretary of the
Citizens’ Advisory Commission on Disabilities. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  5  Romo, Vuong, Dean, Garbutt, Swanson
No:  0  None

Disabilities.

 There being no further nominations, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, declared the nominations
closed for Chair.
